title: Sienna Spiro’s ‘Visitor’ Album Makes Top 10 Debut on Three Charts
summary: It’s the singer-songwriter’s first full-length studio set.
contentText:
Sienna Spiro scores her first entry on any Billboard album chart, as her debut full-length studio set, Visitor , launches in the top 10 on three rankings (dated July 18). It bows in the top 10 on the Billboard 200 (No. 9), Vinyl Albums (No. 3) and Top Album Sales (No. 4). Visitor follows Spiro’s 2025 EP Sink Now, Swim Later .

Visitor was preceded by a trio of Billboard Hot 100-charting hits from the English singer-songwriter’s album: “The Visitor” (No. 43 peak in March), “You Stole the Show” (No. 55 in February) and “Die on This Hill” (No. 19 in February). The lattermost track is Spiro’s current promoted radio single, which has become a top 10 hit on the Pop Airplay and Adult Pop Airplay charts.

Concurrently with Visitor ’s album chart arrival, its new single “Great Expectation,” debuts at No. 91 on the Hot 100.

On the Top Album Sales chart, Visitor is one of four debuts in the top 10, where Madonna’s CONFESSIONS II starts atop the tally. Plus, THE 8 and Vernon’s V8 debuts at No. 7 while Deep Purple’s SPLAT! enters at No. 10. ATEEZ’s GOLDEN HOUR : PART.5 falls to No. 2 after debuting in the top slot a week ago, Olivia Rodrigo’s former No. 1 you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love slips 2-4 and Michael Jackson’s Thriller (up 6-5) rounds out the top five.

As for the rest of the holdovers in the top 10, CORTIS’ chart-topping GREENGREEN is up one spot to No. 6, BTS’ former leader ARIRANG is a non-mover at No. 8, Jackson’s Number Ones steps 11-9.
